scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c yellow,green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @vet/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @vet/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @vet/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vet/shared && npm run build --workspace @vet/backend && npm run build --workspace @vet/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @vet/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @vet/backend && npm run lint --workspace @vet/frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace @vet/backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace @vet/frontend
